facts.text: Muir is at the centre of the Halifax waterfront, in the heart of the new Queen's Marque district.
facts.excerpt: Muir is at the very centre of the dynamic Halifax Waterfront in the heart of the new Queen's Marque district.

facts.text: The Queen's Marque district offers access to the Atlantic Ocean and a multi-million-dollar public art collection.
facts.excerpt: The district offers unprecedented access to the Atlantic Ocean, a multi-million-dollar public art collection

facts.text: Little Wing, Muir's 36-foot Morris yacht, gives guests a view of the coastline from the water.
facts.excerpt: From Little Wing, Muir's 36-foot Morris yacht, guests will get a rare perspective of this much-loved coastline.

facts.text: Scheduled excursions on Reach, the hotel's high-speed 24-foot motorboat, explore the bays and coves of Halifax's historic harbour.
facts.excerpt: Feel the salt spray and ocean wind on your skin on our high-speed 24-foot motorboat, Reach. Exclusive scheduled excursions and tours will explore the dozens of bays and coves throughout Halifax's historic harbour.

facts.text: True Colours is a private art gallery for hotel guests with a rotating collection of exhibits.
facts.excerpt: True Colours, a private art gallery exclusively for our guests. Explore a rotating collection of exhibits that speak to a distinct sense of place.

facts.text: True Colours hosts regular gallery talks and intimate events.
facts.excerpt: True Colours invites guests to deeply connect with the exhibits through regular gallery talks and intimate events.

facts.text: All rooms and suites feature Aesop bath products, custom-made furnishings, original Nova Scotia landscape paintings and ceramics, and a handcrafted walnut bar.
facts.excerpt: all rooms and suites feature Aesop bath products, custom-made furnishings, original Nova Scotia landscape paintings and ceramics, and a handcrafted walnut bar.

facts.text: Rooms have furniture and lighting designed and crafted in Canada, curved white oak walls and walnut-panelled flooring.
facts.excerpt: custom furniture and lighting designed and crafted in Canada, lighting and drapery with custom dimming options and rooms with curved white oak walls and walnut-panelled flooring.

facts.text: The Shannon and Thrumcap Suites were designed by Canada's Studio Munge and include a living room and dining area.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Canada’s Studio Munge, these residential-style suites include one king-size bed, living room, dining area

facts.text: The suites' granite bathrooms have harbour views, a wet room, a floating tub and custom Nova Scotia bath salts.
facts.excerpt: These granite bathrooms boast harbour views and feature a wet room, floating tub, Aesop bath products and custom Nova Scotia bath salts.

facts.text: The Watch, the presidential suite, juts over Halifax harbour with ocean views on three sides.
facts.excerpt: Jutting dramatically over the Halifax harbour with ocean views on three sides, The Watch is a unique Canadian experience.

facts.text: Windward Wellness includes a fitness centre, spin and yoga studio, exercise classes, vitality spa pool, cold plunge pool, halotherapy salt room, eucalyptus steam room and infrared sauna.
facts.excerpt: Access to Windward Wellness, including ultra-premium fitness centre, spin and yoga studio, exercise classes, vitality spa pool, cold plunge pool, halotherapy salt room, eucalyptus steam room and infrared sauna.

facts.text: BKS is a guests-only secret speakeasy that opens onto an elevated waterfront terrace jutting out into the harbour.
facts.excerpt: This secret speakeasy opens onto an elevated waterfront terrace, jutting out into the harbour

facts.text: Drift serves modern, elevated takes on classic Atlantic Canadian dishes.
facts.excerpt: Drift features modern, elevated takes on classic Atlantic Canadian dishes.

facts.text: Muir offers car and driver service with a hybrid Range Rover.
facts.excerpt: car and driver service with hybrid Range Rover and valet parking

facts.text: Kayaks and bicycles are available to make use of the hotel's direct water access.
facts.excerpt: Make the most of Muir's unprecedented location and direct water access with our kayaks and bicycles.

facts.text: Rooms have triple-paned soundproofed windows with bedside-controlled blackout drapes.
facts.excerpt: Triple-paned sound-proofed windows with bedside controlled blackout drapes and lighting

facts.text: Guests find a significant collection of local and global art throughout the rooms, common areas and outdoor spaces.
facts.excerpt: guests will find a significant collection of local and global art that pays thoughtful tribute to this region and its people.

facts.text: Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
facts.excerpt: No, the rooms at Muir, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Halifax do not permit rollaway beds.

facts.text: The largest-occupancy room is the Signature Double Queen, which sleeps a maximum of three.
facts.excerpt: The largest occupancy room at Muir, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Halifax is the Signature Double Queen with a maximum occupancy of 3.

facts.text: BKS has the most sought-after waterfront terrace in the city.
facts.excerpt: complete with access to the most sought-after waterfront terrace in the city.
